title: Great app
body: This helps me to feed my lizard with healthy food. Before it was plum and now with the help of this app it is healthy.
author: CatKitty101

title: Newest version is a disaster
body: After I updated to the newest version, I lost all my progress and had to restore my streaks from a back up from 12 days ago (and then complete the missing streaks manually day by day). But this is not the worst of it! Turns out there is no longer support for Siri within Streaks’ settings so all my custom Siri phrases to complete tasks were gone. Now I have to go through Shortcuts up, but it is severely limited and basically is almost useless in my case a great regression.
author: Lyuben Fedev Ivanov

title: Wonderful app
body: Really helps to form good habits
author: Boropamporo

title: Apple watch data gets corrupted
body:
Latest os on watch and latest app. 
Apple watch displays old deleted task. Newly added tasks cannot be seen in app only in widget as empty circles.
author: alex-d_p

title: Has all the essential tools
body: The app and its interface have nailed down the basics of habit formation tools. It it quite nice that you can’t add a lot of things to keep track of because you will overwhelm yourself. The customisation is insane, the functionality is exceptional and overall the app is worth every cent.
author: ThatBoiX21

title: Instant favorite
body: Polished interface, straightforward functionality, very intuitive and fun, super useful widget.  One of my favorite apps ever.
author: The Bearer of Light

title: Добрия Живот са добрите навици
body: Разбрах за този апп след като гледах наградите на Епъл за най-добри Апове за 2016. Веднага си го купих и 7 месец по-късно мога да кажа само ... купете си го и вие! Помага неимоверно за изграждането на добри навици всеки ден и подръжката е на най високо ниво
author: lantinian

title: Like it!
